title: Letter Blocks
commonMistakes: Recording first occurrences instead of last occurrences
Cutting a block before every contained letter has appeared for the final time
Losing track of the start index for the next block
Returning characters or substrings instead of block lengths
followUps: How would you return the actual substrings as well as their lengths?
What changes if the string is a stream and its final length is unknown?
How would you minimize the number of blocks under the same uniqueness rule?
